authorization: The user approved execution of the frozen minimal-M2 plus minimal stochastic-observation completion experiment after reviewing the 20-network M2 solution distribution.
scientific_question: Does one fixed support-observation uncertainty process supply the missing stable individualized Liu phenotype while the frozen minimal single-P M2 computation preserves coherent relational organization?
claim_boundary: This is an acute model-level intervention on already trained M2 checkpoints. It tests functional sufficiency under the frozen model and cannot establish how the networks learned, how humans encode evidence, or a human neural mechanism.
The earlier 3/3 acute observation result belongs to a different 38-channel P-L architecture and is rationale only, not evidence about M2.
All twenty M2 networks and all three existing Liu panels are mandatory. No seed, panel, participant, relation, checkpoint, or condition may be selected or replaced from the new outcomes.
No network is trained or adapted. Architecture, eta, modulation, P dynamics, readout, response temperature, support history, query inputs, and choice seeds remain frozen.
One inherited sigma=1/7 is fixed prospectively. There is no dose grid, human fitting, threshold fitting, or result-conditioned continuation.
Historical human intervals and nine-row classifiers are exposed evaluation references. Quantitative interval membership is descriptive only and cannot select sigma, models, outcomes, or promotion.
A sign-restored folded condition is an oracle amplitude-matched control, not a proposed human observation mechanism.

The frozen 18 stable_constructive versus 2 nonconstructive split is an outcome-independent baseline stratification. The two-network stratum is descriptive and cannot support a population interaction claim.
The study reports a distribution of acute responses. It cannot promote a final main model or justify deleting checkpoints, changing M2, or adding observation-noise training.

design.units: Every network by panel by condition unit is evaluated. Participants remain nested in panels and are never pooled across networks.
design.pairing: Within a panel, all conditions use the identical task, support cues, base q, queries, choices, and one shared epsilon array. Across networks, each condition uses the same frozen panel inputs.

baseline_strata.provenance: Frozen before this study by the parent three-panel generic result; not recomputed or altered from observation outcomes.
baseline_strata.inference: Primary reporting includes all twenty networks. Strata are descriptive effect-modifier summaries; no inferential comparison is claimed for the two-network nonconstructive stratum.

architecture.model: Exactly the locked 32-channel H=200 M2 checkpoints with direct P expression, one learned scalar eta, one scalar modulation head, no alpha, no L, no normalized time, and no terminal-P penalty.
architecture.state_policy: For each subject-condition support history, h and E reset per trial, P persists across support trials, and every query reads the same terminal P with fresh h/E and no writeback.
architecture.immutability: All model tensor hashes must match the parent joint model lock before and after every evaluation unit.

observation.units: One displayed rank-difference unit divided by n_items-1=7; inherited computational assumption, not estimated from Liu choices.
observation.base: q0 is the exact clean realized observation already frozen in the parent M2 Liu input.
observation.noise: For each panel, epsilon is one float64 numpy default_rng standard-normal array with the exact shape of local_evidence, seeded by 982000+100*panel. It is independent across actual support presentations and subjects and shared by folded and noisy.
observation.clean: Return the parent input arrays byte-equivalently; q_clean=q0.
observation.folded: q_folded=float32(sign(displayed_signed_magnitude)*abs(float64(q0)+sigma*epsilon)). This exactly matches abs(q_noisy) while restoring the displayed relation direction.
observation.routing: Write the condition q only to the single M2 evidence input used by the legacy-shaped read-only adapter. Keep the corresponding legacy zq bookkeeping channel synchronized as trial_retention*q for inherited evidence interventions; M2 does not read that channel.
observation.scope: Support step zero only. Query inputs receive no added observation noise. Task labels, metadata, retention, pair identities, choice random numbers, and all other tensors are unchanged.
observation.subject_stability: A subject receives one fixed support epsilon history and therefore one fixed terminal P within a condition. Repeated query choices retain the inherited independent choice draws; no choice realization is copied to manufacture stability.
observation.zero_and_pairing_checks: Qualification must prove clean identity, sigma=0 identity, folded/noisy absolute-amplitude equality, folded displayed-sign restoration, same epsilon use, support-only mutation, deterministic regeneration, and no model access to the bookkeeping zq channel.

evaluation.liu: Reuse the parent three frozen Liu panels, temperature 0.25, and existing intact, P_off, evidence_shuffle, query_shuffle structural no-op, and single-relation-removal analyses.

primary_missing_phenotypes.difficult_pair_bimodality: Existing qualitative classifier: at least 15 bimodal pairs and no ordinary-unimodal or low-accuracy pair. Continuous endpoint is the number of bimodal pairs.
primary_missing_phenotypes.stable_within_subject_errors: Existing qualitative classifier: analysis-cohort prevalence of at least one pair wrong on at least 80 percent of trials is at least 0.80. Continuous endpoint is that prevalence.
primary_missing_phenotypes.inter_subject_ranking_diversity: Existing qualitative classifier: mean pairwise Kendall tau among eligible non-correct Hodge rankings is below 0.80. Continuous endpoint is tau, with lower values indicating more diversity.

preservation.evidence_binding: The intact-minus-evidence_shuffle learned probability participant bootstrap lower bound must be positive.
preservation.interpretation: A panel is structured_complete only when all three primary qualitative flags and all six preservation qualitative flags pass and evidence binding is positive. Quantitative human-interval flags are reported but never gate structured completion.

evaluation.continuous_contrasts: For each condition and network, average each primary continuous endpoint over the three panels without pooling participants. Across the twenty paired networks, report mean noisy-clean and noisy-folded differences with 2000 percentile bootstrap draws. Expected directions are positive for bimodal-pair count and stable-error prevalence and negative for Kendall tau.

bootstrap.unit: Paired resampling of twenty networks after within-network panel averaging; panels and participants are not treated as independent networks.
bootstrap.undefined: A missing or nonfinite primary endpoint makes that network-condition endpoint undefined and blocks a registered direction-specific conclusion; it is never silently dropped.

evaluation.descriptive_quantitative: Report all historical nine-row quantitative calibration flags and continuous summaries for every panel. They do not enter any outcome label.

decision.per_panel_structured_complete: All nine historical qualitative flags pass and intact-minus-evidence_shuffle learned probability has a finite bootstrap lower bound above zero.
decision.per_network_stable_complete: All three panels are structured_complete in that condition.
decision.direction_specific_continuous_support: All three across-network noisy-minus-folded primary contrast intervals exclude zero in the registered expected direction.
decision.clean_completion_support: All three across-network noisy-minus-clean primary contrast intervals exclude zero in the registered expected direction.

outcomes.no_acute_completion: No network is stable_complete under noisy observation.
outcomes.direction_specific_acute_completion: At least one network is stable_complete under noisy observation, both clean_completion_support and direction_specific_continuous_support hold, and every noisy stable-complete panel satisfies preservation by construction.
outcomes.acute_completion_without_direction_speci: At least one network is stable_complete under noisy observation, but the registered direction-specific outcome is not met. Report whether folded also completes and which continuous contrasts remain unidentified or inconsistent.

decision.no_promotion: main_model_promoted is always false. A positive development result may motivate a separately frozen replication but cannot trigger training, sigma selection, or checkpoint cleanup.

qualification.fixtures: Synthetic non-Liu arrays and M2 seeds outside 3041--3060. Qualification cannot evaluate any parent scientific checkpoint under folded or noisy observation.
qualification.operator: Test every observation identity and mutation boundary, including exact clean identity, sigma-zero identity, amplitude equality, sign restoration away from exact zero, deterministic seeds, and unchanged query/label/metadata tensors.
qualification.adapter: Reconfirm on synthetic eager and compiled CPU/CUDA fixtures that M2 native channel 31 and adapter channel 37 produce matching margins/states, and channel 34 changes alone cannot alter M2 outputs.
qualification.decisions: Synthetic fixtures must cover structured completion, preservation failure, undefined endpoints, all outcome branches, paired-bootstrap directions, and exact network/panel/condition identities.
qualification.failure: Any failed qualification blocks input/source locking and all scientific evaluation. Repairs after outcome exposure require a separate append-only repair contract and cannot change the scientific protocol.

execution.runtime: CUDA float32 without autocast or TF32; inherited compiled M2 evaluation; one Torch/BLAS/compiler thread; float64 observation proposal and summaries.
freeze_points: Commit this protocol and initial study registration before implementing the operator or exposing any M2 observation outcome.
Commit the qualified implementation plus source/input lock, including every epsilon and encoded-condition fingerprint, before evaluating seed3041 panel1.
Evaluate all 180 network-panel-condition units without inspecting a partial scientific summary, freeze the canonical result and report, then stop.
execution.retention: Keep the protocol, qualification, source/input lock, canonical result, concise report, and sufficient per-unit artifacts. Reuse parent checkpoints by verified reference; do not duplicate or delete them.
